BILL.why: The best-built base on the list from a market leader, its advance speeding up on heavier-than-normal volume and not yet stretched past the breakout.
BILL.contested: Contested: the objection wants the pullback into the rising 20-day average rather than buying the break, and that pullback holding would clear it.

CHYM.why: A just-happened breakout on more than twice normal volume from a stock that beat almost the whole market over six months, still close to the break.
CHYM.contested: Contested: the objections call the turn early, with the hourly chart still falling and the entry chasing the break, and a daily close above Friday's high would clear them.

ABNB.why: A market leader 0.3% under its 52-week high on the heaviest volume in the set, with higher highs and higher lows on the weekly and daily charts.
ABNB.contested: Contested: the objection says a name already through resistance should be bought on the break with no pullback asked for, and dropping that pullback condition would clear it.

KO.contested: Contested: the break came on normal volume and the trigger writes no volume level, so an hourly break on at least 1.4 times normal volume would clear it.
